Despite Putin’s nuclear “sabre-rattling”, Kaliningrad is far from the "formidable military fortress" it is often portrayed as. Russia’s grip on its isolated Baltic exclave is “increasingly fragile”, potentially making it Putin’s Achilles’ heel, says Edward Lucas.

Edward Lucas was speaking to Kait Borsay on The Evening Edition on Times Radio. Listen live every Monday-Thursday from 7-10pm
